notes.title: Official PsychoFlux Community Discord server opened!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6188768/c9cda001e75df7f55c5ae9d40ed84734d9e08f46.gif[/img]

Hello there!

We're glad to announce that the [b]PsychoFlux Community Discord[/b] server just opened yesterday! Jump in right now; let's just hang out! To join the server, type Discord dot GG, slash PsychoFlux on your browser, or just simply click this link: [b][i]https://discord.gg/psychoflux[/i][/b]

Oh, and perhaps you might grab a chance to talk directly with the developers of our games... so come and check it out.

We'll see you there!

notes.title: Day One Patch Summary (August 10th, 2018)
notes.notes:
The following issues have been addressed through multiple updates.
[list][*]Fixed an error related to game resolution.
[*]Fixed an issue where certain Achievements would not be unlocked.
[*]Fixed an issue where game menu did not respond to clicks at certain aspect ratio, or under certain conditions.[/list]

notes.title: Colorzzle is now available on Steam
notes.notes:
Hello there!

'Colorzzle' developed by Darong Studio was released on Steam today(August 10th, 00:00 PST). You can get it for $1.99(USD), and Steam version for Colorzzle will include the following:
[list][*]Steam Achievements
[*]50+ Steam-exclusive bonus levels
[*]Steam Trading Cards [i](to be activated later due to [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/593110/announcements/detail/1954971077935370845]Valve's policy[/url])[/i][/list]

Hope you enjoy the game! Thanks a lot.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/818500/Colorzzle/
